name: Troll Tribal Necklace
summary: Troll Tribal Necklaces are carried by forest trolls in the Hinterlands. The Wildhammers of Aerie Peak value them as proof that outsiders are willing to earn their regard.

sections.title: Aerie Peak’s Measure
sections.body: Fraggar Thundermantle asks you to bring five Troll Tribal Necklaces to Aerie Peak. The Wildhammers are independent, and they judge those who seek their friendship by deeds. Fraggar counts the necklaces as a step toward winning their good graces.

faq.answer: Fraggar Thundermantle at Aerie Peak asks you to bring him five Troll Tribal Necklaces.

faq.q: Why do the Wildhammers want them?
faq.answer: Fraggar treats the necklaces as proof that you are willing to get your hands dirty and earn the Wildhammers’ regard.

faq.q: Where do the necklaces come from?
faq.answer: Forest trolls in the Hinterlands carry Troll Tribal Necklaces.

faq.q: How many necklaces does Fraggar ask for?
faq.answer: Fraggar asks you to bring five Troll Tribal Necklaces to Aerie Peak.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can earn the regard of the independent Wildhammer dwarves through deeds.
